name: Clasherball
long_description:
Navigate unique puzzles in Arcade mode or see how long you can survive in Infinite mode!
Match for balls of the same color to CLASH! But watch out! Balls will fly back and damage you after they clash. Get out of the way to stay alive. 
Use tricks like curve shots and ricochets to solve brain bending puzzles!
This Demo contains one World with 15 Stages.
Infinite lets you play and enjoy the game as much as you want!

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
